purpose: verify audio claims vs measured evidence

claims: All 305 sample spans in the 27 FR2 sound banks have lengths that are multiples of 16 bytes, begin with an all-zero block, end with a block whose end flag is set, and contain zero blocks violating the filter<=4, shift<=12, flags<=7 rules.
Bank sample spans fall into exactly two terminator classes: a single final block with flags 3 (206 spans) and a flag-1 block followed by a flag-7 block (99 spans).

The reference decoder produces bounded output: the maximum fraction of full-scale samples in any bank span is below 0.0003 and in the decoded music excerpts is 0.
Control files (ps2, ptg, dat) violate the filter<=4 rule in 39 to 96 percent of 16-byte blocks, so the structure test discriminates ADPCM from unrelated data.
The real-corpus audio verification passes and the full suite of 32 tests passes.
The decoded audio has been verified to play correctly in the game and to sound correct to a listener.
The .mih word at index 1 has been identified as the loop start offset of the music streams.
